# Remote Team Meeting Plan — 2026-06-18 2:00 PM ET

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

This 90-minute meeting is structured for 8 people across 3 time zones, with tight time blocks and clear decision points. It keeps the discussion focused on status, blockers, and next steps, then ends with ownership and follow-up.

## Meeting Flow and Time Blocks

| Time (ET) | Block | Purpose | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2:00–2:05 PM | Opening | Goals, agenda, timekeeping | Shared expectations |
| 2:05–2:25 PM | Project status | Rapid updates from each workstream | Current progress snapshot |
| 2:25–2:50 PM | Blockers review | Surface risks, dependencies, decisions needed | Blocker list with owners |
| 2:50–3:10 PM | Next steps | Confirm priorities and sequencing | Action items and deadlines |
| 3:10–3:20 PM | Wrap-up | Recap, confirm follow-up, close | Final summary |

## Concise Agenda for a 90-Minute Remote Meeting

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

- **2:00–2:05** — Welcome, purpose, and decision goals
- **2:05–2:25** — Project status by owner, 2–3 minutes each
- **2:25–2:50** — Blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies
- **2:50–3:10** — Next steps, priority order, and owners
- **3:10–3:20** — Recap, deadlines, and meeting close

### Remote-friendly facilitation notes
- Ask each speaker to keep updates to **60–90 seconds**.
- Use a shared notes doc so everyone can follow decisions in real time.
- Call on people in a round-robin order to avoid overlap.
- Reserve the last 10 minutes for commitments only, not new discussion.

## Time Zone-Friendly Attendance View

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

- **America/New_York:** 2:00 PM
- **America/Chicago:** 1:00 PM
- **America/Los_Angeles:** 11:00 AM

## Follow-Up Email Draft

**Subject:** Meeting recap and next steps — June 18 team sync

Hi team,

Thanks for joining today’s meeting. We reviewed project status, surfaced key blockers, and aligned on next steps.

**Key takeaways**
- Project status was reviewed across all active workstreams.
- Main blockers and dependencies were identified and assigned.
- Next steps, owners, and deadlines were confirmed.

**Action items**
- [Owner 1] to complete [task] by [date]
- [Owner 2] to resolve [blocker] by [date]
- [Owner 3] to share [deliverable] by [date]

Please reply in-thread if I missed anything or if any action item needs correction.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
